features.title: Field engineer
features.text: Mechanics hack and repair technology. Temporary modifications can improve a weapon's range or let armor hover above the ground.

features.title: Exocortex
features.text: An exocortex links their mind to a drone, turret or set of mines. Directing it takes actions that could otherwise go toward attacks or repairs.
